description: This source file implements functions for handling various Wi-Fi management frames, including association responses, association requests, authentication frames, and public action frames for a Wi-Fi hardware abstraction layer. It defines callback mechanisms, processes specific frame types, and interacts with relevant Wi-Fi protocols.

methods.name: int handle_assoc_rsp_frame(INT ap_index,mac_address_t sta_mac,unsigned char * frame,UINT len)
methods.description: Handles association response frames by invoking the registered callback if available.

methods.name: int handle_assoc_req_frame(INT ap_index,mac_address_t sta_mac,unsigned char * frame,UINT len)
methods.description: Handles association request frames and invokes the associated callback.

methods.name: int handle_auth_frame(INT ap_index,mac_address_t sta_mac,unsigned char * frame,UINT len,wifi_direction_t dir)
methods.description: Processes authentication frames and calls the appropriate callback based on the frame direction (uplink or downlink).

methods.name: int handle_gas_init_public_action_frame(INT ap_index,mac_address_t sta_mac,unsigned char * public_action_data,UINT len)
methods.description: Processes GAS initial request frames, identifies the protocol, and triggers relevant callbacks for DPP or ANQP requests.

methods.name: int handle_vendor_public_action_frame(INT ap_index,mac_address_t sta_mac,unsigned char * public_action_data,UINT len)
methods.description: Handles vendor-specific public action frames, specifically DPP frames identified by their OUI, and invokes the callback.

methods.name: int handle_public_action_frame(INT ap_index,mac_address_t sta_mac,wifi_publicActionFrameHdr_t * ppublic_hdr,UINT len)
methods.description: Dispatches public action frames based on their type, such as vendor-specific or GAS initialization requests.

methods.name: int mgmt_frame_received_callback(INT ap_index,mac_address_t sta_mac,UCHAR * frame,UINT len,wifi_mgmtFrameType_t type,wifi_direction_t dir)
methods.description: Main callback function for received management frames; dispatches to specific handlers based on frame type.

methods.name: void wifi_assoc_rsp_frame_callback_register(wifi_sentAssocRspFrame_callback func)
methods.description: Registers a callback for when an association response frame is transmitted.

methods.name: void wifi_assoc_req_frame_callback_register(wifi_receivedAssocReqFrame_callback func)
methods.description: Registers a callback for when an association request frame is received.

methods.name: void wifi_auth_frame_tx_callback_register(wifi_sentAuthFrame_callback func)
methods.description: Registers a callback for when an authentication frame is transmitted.

methods.name: void wifi_auth_frame_rx_callback_register(wifi_receivedAuthFrame_callback func)
methods.description: Registers a callback for when an authentication frame is received.
